title: Faro and the Moonlit Gate Flags
description: A little marigold follow-me car and his seafoam baggage-tug friend gather colorful gate flags across a quiet evening airport, then rest beneath the moonlit control tower.

Faro.role: Main character; a little airport follow-me car
Faro.color: Warm marigold-yellow body with a cream roof, one navy-blue side stripe, and a tiny white crescent-moon emblem on each front door
Faro.bodyShape: Small rounded compact follow-me car with four small charcoal tires, a short amber roof beacon bar, and a dark grille smile; no arms or hands
Faro.face: Exactly two large friendly eyes located in the two front headlights; no windshield eyes and nothing else resembling eyes
Faro.accessories: Short amber roof beacon; crescent-moon door emblems; no lettering, logos, or numbers

Brio.role: Supporting character; a little baggage tug
Brio.color: Soft seafoam-green body with a cream bumper and one amber roof beacon
Brio.bodyShape: Small baggage tug with a short square cab, tiny luggage platform behind, and four charcoal wheels; no arms or hands
Brio.face: Exactly two friendly eyes located in the two front headlights; no windshield eyes and no other eye-like lights; gentle grille smile
Brio.accessories: Amber roof beacon; luggage platform for carrying gate flags

settingBible.Willowwing Airport: A cozy regional airport with a smooth gray apron, low terminal with warm amber windows, blue taxiway edge lights, distant parked aircraft without faces, a moonlit control tower, and rolling purple hills beyond
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded airport vehicles, blue-hour evening fading to moonlit night, one scene per page, and no readable text on story pages

continuityRules: Faro keeps marigold-yellow body, cream roof, navy side stripe, crescent-moon door emblems, and eyes only in the two headlights.
Brio keeps seafoam-green body, cream bumper, luggage platform, and eyes only in the two headlights.
Page 7 narrates a navy moon flag at the fence to match the art.
Pages 9 and 12 avoid exact flag counts.
Page 14 keeps Faro's amber roof beacon lit.
Page 15 keeps Faro calm at bedtime.
No rescue, danger, lettering, logos, or numerals in artwork.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words on story-page artwork.

pages.text: Evening settled softly over Willowwing Airport as Faro began his last quiet round.
pages.illustrationScene: Marigold follow-me car Faro rolls alone along the blue-hour airport apron with warm terminal lights behind him.
pages.continuityNotes: Faro alone on page 1; Brio absent. Headlight eyes only.

pages.text: Brio rolled beside him, carrying a neat bundle of colorful gate flags.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro and seafoam baggage tug Brio roll side by side, Brio carrying a tidy stack of colorful gate flags.
pages.continuityNotes: Brio present from page 2 with colorful flags. Soft flag wording when counts are loose.

pages.text: A playful breeze suddenly lifted the flags and sent them fluttering across the apron.
pages.illustrationScene: Colorful fabric flags lift from Brio's platform and flutter separately across the quiet apron as Faro and Brio watch calmly.
pages.continuityNotes: Flags scatter; no danger or strong storm. Soft flag counts later.

pages.text: We can gather them slowly, said Faro. One gate at a time.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro and Brio pause together on the apron, looking thoughtfully toward a nearby gate under glowing taxiway lights.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm plan to gather flags gate by gate.

pages.text: A coral flag rested beside a quiet luggage cart, and Faro found it first.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro discovers a coral flag resting beside a parked luggage cart while Brio approaches behind him.
pages.continuityNotes: First recovered flag is coral beside a luggage cart.

pages.text: Brio spotted the yellow flag tucked safely beside a painted curb.
pages.illustrationScene: Brio finds a butter-yellow flag tucked beside a painted curb while Faro watches happily nearby.

pages.text: Farther along, a navy flag with a soft moon danced against the fence without blowing away.
pages.illustrationScene: A navy fabric flag with a yellow crescent moon flutters against a low airport fence as Faro and Brio approach.
pages.continuityNotes: Art shows a navy moon flag at the fence, not a plain sky-blue flag.

pages.text: Faro followed the glowing taxiway lights and found the lavender flag near a quiet gate.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro follows curved blue taxiway lights toward a lavender flag near a quiet gate marker, with Brio behind him.
pages.continuityNotes: Lavender flag near a quiet gate; avoid exact gate numbers.

pages.text: A mint flag was still missing, so they listened to the soft evening breeze.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro and Brio pause near airport benches beneath twilight with recovered flags on Brio's platform, listening for the missing mint flag.
pages.continuityNotes: Do not narrate exact recovered flag counts; mint flag still missing.

pages.text: A tiny flutter came from beneath a bench, and there was the last mint flag.
pages.illustrationScene: A mint fabric flag peeks from beneath an airport bench while Faro and Brio spot it happily.
pages.continuityNotes: Final mint flag found beneath a bench.

pages.text: Faro and Brio carried every flag back to the quiet gate lane.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro leads Brio back toward the gate lane with recovered colorful flags neatly on Brio's platform under a starry blue sky.
pages.timeOfDay: early night return to gate lane
pages.continuityNotes: Returning with gathered flags; soft count wording.

pages.text: Together they arranged the colors in a cheerful row beneath the warm terminal lights.
pages.illustrationScene: Colorful gate flags stand in a cheerful row beneath warm terminal lights while Faro and Brio admire them.
pages.continuityNotes: Do not narrate an exact flag count in the arranged row.

pages.text: The final airplane rolled gently to its resting place while the little flags waved goodnight.
pages.illustrationScene: A distant un-faced airplane rolls toward its resting gate while flags wave softly and Faro and Brio watch beneath the moon.
pages.continuityNotes: Airplane has no face; soft flag wording.

pages.text: Brio parked his empty tug, and Faro rested nearby with his amber roof light still glowing.
pages.illustrationScene: Brio rests with an empty platform while Faro parks nearby with his amber roof beacon still lit under stars.
pages.continuityNotes: Art keeps Faro's amber beacon lit; do not say it is dimmed.

pages.text: Under the moonlit control tower, Faro grew calm and whispered goodnight to Willowwing Airport.
pages.illustrationScene: Faro rests calmly beneath the moonlit control tower with Brio farther back, terminal windows softly glowing.
pages.continuityNotes: Faro is calm at bedtime; airport settled and quiet.
